photometric_floor_method: For each 0.1 um source-wavelength bin, compute 1.4826*MAD of log(measured_flux/catalog_interpolated_flux) across comparison stars. Convert the robust fractional scatter to Jy using the control-star smooth-model flux at that wavelength and add in quadrature to its formal flux uncertainty.
astrometric_threshold_method: Per frame, subtract the median east/north Gaia residual across selected comparison stars; set the displacement threshold to three times 1.4826*MAD of radial residuals after subtracting the common frame offset. Require at least 20 comparison stars in a frame.
